Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

Here are my top 4 hotels in the two best neighborhoods to stay in.

In midtown, the Arlo Midtown is my 4 star pick, and the Arlo Suite comes with the largest outdoor terrace I have ever had at a hotel, with views of the Empire State Building, World Trade Center, and Hudson Yards from one spot. My 5 star pick is the Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards, where you get complimentary access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. Ask for the Deluxe One Bedroom Suite.

Down in SoHo, the Arlo SoHo is the fun one with constant rooftop events, and the City Terrace room gets you private outdoor space. And The Manner is the most unique boutique hotel I have stayed at in Manhattan. The rooms do not come with a TV, but ask for one and it arrives in a suitcase.

Use code TYLERLCRAWFORD for up to 40% off at Arlo. Save this for when you are booking and send it to the friend you are going with.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

In midtown, the Arlo Midtown is my 4 star pick, and the Arlo Suite comes with the largest outdoor terrace I have ever had at a hotel, with views of the Empire State Building, World Trade Center, and Hudson Yards from one spot. My 5 star pick is the Equinox Hotel in Hudson Yards, where you get complimentary access to the largest Equinox ever built at 60,000 square feet. Ask for the Deluxe One Bedroom Suite.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

Save this for when you set up your own space, and send it to whoever’s apartment never feels finished.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.
